title: Loon acquires CADC and assumes issuer responsibility
description: Loon announced that it had acquired the CADC stablecoin, originally launched by PayTrie in 2021, and would assume responsibility as its new issuer.
notes: This event records current issuer succession. It does not establish CADC's original 2021 launch day.

title: ZARP migrates to a Solana Token-2022 mint
description: ZARP announced migration of its Solana representation to a new Token-2022 contract, and current official blockchain documentation publishes the successor Solana mint.
notes: Current Solana identifier is canonical. Complete legacy token and migration-mechanics reconstruction remains an explicit research gap.
